urls.title: Target Webpage URLs
urls.description: List of webpage URLs to fetch, strip noise, and convert into clean LLM-ready format.

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description: Choose output formatting: clean Markdown, raw clean text, or structured JSON sections.

includeLinks.title: Include Hyperlinks
includeLinks.description: Preserve markdown hyperlinks [text](url). Set to false to reduce token usage.

includeTables.title: Include Markdown Tables
includeTables.description: Format HTML tables into clean GitHub-flavored Markdown tables.

maxTokensPerUrl.title: Max Tokens Per Page
maxTokensPerUrl.description: Maximum token budget per webpage before truncation. Default 4000 tokens (~16,000 characters).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration to bypass Cloudflare and CAPTCHAs.
